scope.scope: One zero-physics assessment of existing259 finite contact returns and267 point records; 1000 poststep intervals8.005-13s x24cases x2feet.
scope.normal: Retain every returned normal point including zero force. Group positive loads, separate signs of endstate normal velocity and separation, report scaled normal-row singular values/rank with numerical1e-10 threshold.
scope.friction: Use separate friction points; no matching to normal points or inferred patch association. Report sum of force magnitudes divided by sum scalar normal force as descriptive demand, not utilization or capacity.
scope.timing: Returned forces use original dt=.005 (impulse/dt). Pair them with same poststep backend point velocity and same-material pose difference over(k-1,k] separately. Neither pairing is internal-stage work or measured dissipated power; no timing fit.
scope.coverage: All foot records retained. Observed floor-only flags from296 separately describe wholebody external-wrench completeness; incomplete cases never certify full external closure.
not_observed: Friction patch IDs, combined coefficients, anchors and broken flags
scope.constraints: No runtime/control/material/solver/quiet-guard/physical-criterion/authority change. No forward prediction, fitted offsets, extra physics or PPO. Derived FD used only for offline comparison, never replacing rawqd.
